metadata.description: 从本地材料笔记库里检索，把一张成品卡直接插进输入框：定义、要点、出处都在里面。库位置由你自己配置，包里不含任何人的路径。 · Search a local material-notes library and drop a finished card into the message box: definition, key points and provenance, configured by you.
